# Official scoring program (not included)

Place `scoring.py` from the official RealPDE Track 1 starting kit here, as `vendor/starting_kit_v9/scoring.py`.

The training pipeline never imports this file. It only checks the file's sha256 as a source pin, so the file must be byte-identical to the original:

```
a144853b1bc1ff79bb8d40601629f23460ac12af95678577e9a1b59949294d39  scoring.py
```

The file is the organizers' code and is not redistributed in this repository.
